The '''Iliabath system''' was located in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Insurrection of Iliabath]]<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref> took place in the vicinity of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="Battlenamia">{{Battlenamia|event=the [[Insurrection of Iliabath]]|system=Iliabath [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> at some point by [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]'', by the time of which the [[Insurrection of Iliabath]] had taken place, to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Iliabath system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-4.<ref name="TEA" />
